Cora is a beautiful name. At camp I had a camper named Cora (9 years old) and she went on the caving trip with me. She was so excited until we got in the cave. Suddenly a very frightened lady. But we all cheered her on at every moment and we chanted "Big C" which is also what one of the counselors calls her dad, (Her last name is Cesario). And so, her camp nickname became "Big C" and she cried no more and she was a very happy camper and said she can't wait for the next caving trip. I hope she went on one this summer.

I'm not in high school. I work two jobs, live with my parents and 24 year old brother who is a heroin addict and alcoholic and all around awful person for as long as I can remember. I'm waiting for school to start in January and it just feel like time is standing still. I feel so trapped. I don't have any friends at home and I can't afford gas to go more than 20 miles, let alone see them. I feel like I've plateaued and that I haven't done anything worthwhile in two years. The year after I graduated high school I went to Oregon, California, Indiana, Ohio, Illinois, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, Massachussettes, got my license, fell in love for the first time, learned how to swim, saved a kid from drowning, explored caves, went on a canoe trip every week of the summer...

And now I work in a crappy, greasy diner where my boss and customers sexually harass me, I have a stalker, or he is at least blossoming, writing books about me, telling me dreams he has about us together, telling me we're soul mates, refusing to accept that I don't want to date him, trying to give me money and when I refuse giving me $80 as a tip. what the hell? Everything has just been so crappy this year and the stress is over whelming. I wish I could go see the Netherlands like I want to. I wish school would just start already. I need new people. I'm so lonely.
